# Smallball (Smallball Consulting)

> Practical AI and process consulting for small businesses — based in Bozeman, Montana, serving small businesses anywhere (remote). Founded by Mark Meece, an operator who scaled a business from about $4M to roughly $50M in under seven years. The opposite of a big AI transformation: small, practical AI wins, proven one at a time, documented so they stick, compounding from there. Brand line: "Win the little things."

Key facts:
- Founder: Mark Meece — operator background (COO of Evolution AVA; CEO & owner of Granite Mountain Countertops), not a pure technologist
- Two ways to engage: "We do it for you" (project-based: The Walk-Through → The Build → The System) and "We do it with you" (The Workshop: $1,500/month, two 45-minute working sessions per month plus direct text access, limited to six clients, month to month)
- Everything starts with the Walk-Through: a walk of the client's operation producing a ranked, scoped list of small wins — no obligation
- Common builds: email management, invoice & payment reminders, scheduling & call prep, quote/estimate drafting, lead intake & qualification, receipt capture, weekly client updates, data collection & reports
- Operating rules: automate the schedule not the judgment; fix the process before automating it; every win gets a tracked metric; clients own everything built
- Service area: Bozeman / Gallatin Valley, Montana locally; remote nationwide
- Contact: mark@smallball.consulting
- Booking: https://outlook.office.com/book/smallball1@smallball.consulting/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/smallball-consulting

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.smallball.consulting/): positioning, the Merriam-Webster "small ball" definition, the two paths, the method, founder credibility
- [Find your win (AI advisor)](https://www.smallball.consulting/advisor.html): a free three-minute AI conversation that finds the one small, repeatable thing costing a business the most time — honest about whether the fix is AI, automation, or just a better process; no email required
- [The wins](https://www.smallball.consulting/wins.html): the eight small wins built most often, with honest sourced numbers and a results-vary disclaimer
